item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Meet the Real F-35A

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.

item.tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

answer_sheet.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
answer_sheet.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
answer_sheet.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

must_haves: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

style.prompt: Create an 8-second widescreen factual aviation mini-documentary about the real Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II. Photorealistic documentary footage, authentic real aircraft proportions and engineering, never futuristic or sci-fi. Accurately show a gray F-35A: one engine with ONE rear exhaust nozzle, single-seat canopy, angular stealth fuselage, trapezoidal wings, two outward-canted vertical tail fins, conventional tricycle landing gear. Do not show an F-35B, lift fan, vertical takeoff, hovering, extra engines, extra wings, or fictional aircraft. Sequence: seconds 0–4 side-on telephoto tracking shot of the F-35A accelerating along a real runway, rotating and lifting off conventionally with forward speed. Seconds 4–8 cut to a smooth air-to-air tracking view of the same F-35A flying, gear retracting, with the single rear engine nozzle visible in rear three-quarter view. Natural daylight, restrained documentary color, believable aerodynamics. Clear clean on-screen typography: persistent identification label 'F-35A Lightning II' near the top throughout. Secondary label 'One engine' appears during seconds 0–4, then is replaced by 'Conventional takeoff' during seconds 4–8; show those labels in turn, correctly spelled, no other writing or captions. Sound: calm, clear English documentary narrator, speaking exactly: 'The F-35A Lightning II has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway.' Time the narration to fit all eight seconds without rushing. Very quiet realistic jet ambience beneath the voice; no music.
